newsitem.title: TOGO: Policeman killed in Togo bank holdup.
newsitem.headline: Policeman killed in Togo bank holdup.

text.p: Gunmen killed a policeman during a bank holdup in the Togo capital Lome on Tuesday and escaped with 25 million CFA francs ($48,544) in cash, state radio said.
It quoted the city's police commissioner, Komna Baba, as saying the three gunmen raided the city centre branch of the BIAO Bank as it was taking delivery of cash just before midday.
They escaped in a waiting car.
